verzen.tekst: My heart overflows with a noble theme.
verzen.html: My heart overflows with a noble theme.

verzen.tekst: You are the most excellent of the sons of men.
verzen.html: You are the most excellent of the sons of men.

verzen.tekst: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one,
verzen.html: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one,

verzen.tekst: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness.
verzen.html: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness.

verzen.tekst: Your throne, God, is forever and ever.
verzen.html: Your throne, God, is forever and ever.

verzen.tekst: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness.
verzen.html: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness.

verzen.tekst: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia.
verzen.html: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia.

verzen.tekst: Kings’ daughters are amongst your honourable women.
verzen.html: Kings’ daughters are amongst your honourable women.

verzen.tekst: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear.
verzen.html: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear.

verzen.tekst: So the king will desire your beauty,
verzen.html: So the king will desire your beauty,

verzen.tekst: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift.
verzen.html: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift.

verzen.tekst: The princess inside is all glorious.
verzen.html: The princess inside is all glorious.

verzen.tekst: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work.
verzen.html: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work.

verzen.tekst: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led.
verzen.html: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led.

verzen.tekst: Your sons will take the place of your fathers.
verzen.html: Your sons will take the place of your fathers.

verzen.tekst: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations.
verzen.html: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations.
